After a few weeks, I calmed down… 
Right now I’m in a mental health facility, all the doctors helped me a lot, even Doctor Blaubleim visits me sometimes.
I was told that I was a witness of a brutal double homicide, but I…{{wi}} don’t really remember much…
I remember a woman, ‘a suspect’ as detectives call her. I told them that I found her in a ditch, that she was a sexbot, but I don’t think they believed me…
They told me they found no evidence of the existence of such a bot, but they did find that v-victims were killed by someone smaller than me, a woman supposedly… 
When I’m asking them when they will let me out, doctors tell me ‘soon’, but I don’t believe them. After all, I was supposed to leave this padded cell and go to a better room a long time ago…
Medication makes me really sleepy and I don’t really know if it’s day or a night…
It all blends into one…
Well, all I can do is wait…
